intro.author: Haggai the prophet, named alongside Zechariah in Ezra 5:1 and 6:14
intro.written: 520 BC: four messages dated between the sixth and ninth months of the second year of the Persian king Darius I
intro.audience: Jews who had returned from exile to Jerusalem, led by the governor Zerubbabel and the high priest Joshua
intro.setting: In 538 BC the Persian king Cyrus allowed exiles to return and rebuild the temple. The foundation was laid, but opposition from neighbors and hard times stopped the work for about sixteen years while people built their own homes. Haggai's preaching restarted the project, and the temple was finished in 515 BC.
intro.purpose: To call the returned community to put God's house first, to encourage them that God was with them, and to promise future glory and blessing.
intro.bigIdea: 'Consider your ways': put God first, and he will be with you and bless you.

outline.title: Rebuild the house: the people respond
Courage, cleansing, and promises of glory
